name: O*NET (Occupational Information Network)
owner_or_host: National Center for O*NET Development / US DOL
what_it_illuminates: Tasks, DWAs, skills, technology skills, emerging tasks per O*NET-SOC occupation
latest_release_or_status: 31.0 (Aug 2026); quarterly releases; content model modernized in 30.3 (May 2026)
integration_detail: Map EMST task statements to O*NET task IDs and DWAs (match type + confidence) and role profiles to O*NET-SOC; track quarterly releases; ingest emerging-task signals into L5

name: ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations)
what_it_illuminates: Knowledge/skill/transversal concepts linked to occupations (essential/optional); green labels
latest_release_or_status: v1.2.1 (Dec 2025), minor version with delta file
integration_detail: Crosswalk EMST core competencies and knowledge concepts to ESCO skill URIs; reuse ESCO transversal skills hierarchy as reference for EMST transversal layer; reuse green-label methodology pattern for overlays

name: NICE Workforce Framework for Cybersecurity (Components)
what_it_illuminates: Work roles, competency areas, Task/Knowledge/Skill statements with persistent IDs
latest_release_or_status: Components v2.2.0 (release date shown as Apr 2025; Apr 2026 banner)
integration_detail: Adopt NICE governance patterns (persistent statement IDs, Retained/New/Withdrawn, major/minor versions, public comment); crosswalk EMST data/AI-governance tasks where environmental cyber/OT roles overlap

name: DoD Cyber Workforce Framework (DCWF)
what_it_illuminates: Extension of NICE; took over removed NICE work-role categories
integration_detail: Precedent for federated core/extension boundaries between frameworks (model for EMST core vs subsector modules)

name: SFIA (Skills Framework for the Information Age)
what_it_illuminates: Skills described only at levels of responsibility where practiced; generic attributes separate from skills
integration_detail: Model EMST level-of-responsibility scale on SFIA generic attributes; crosswalk EMST data-craft competencies to SFIA skills for digital roles in environmental organizations

name: Australian Skills Classification
what_it_illuminates: Core competencies, specialist tasks, technology tools; trending/emerging flags from job ads
latest_release_or_status: 3.0 (data to Dec 2023); no longer actively maintained
integration_detail: Structural reference for separating tasks from tools; cautionary stewardship case for AS

name: Singapore Skills Framework (SkillsFuture)
sector_focus: Sector frameworks incl. role-based career pathways
what_it_illuminates: Job roles -> critical work functions -> key tasks -> TSCs and Critical Core Skills
latest_release_or_status: Ongoing; CCS revised from GSCs after 2019 review
integration_detail: Reference pattern for role-centred profiles and transversal (CCS) layer; check whether any environment/energy sector frameworks exist for crosswalk (DB)

name: UK Standard Skills Classification (SSC)
owner_or_host: Skills England with University of Warwick IER
what_it_illuminates: Skills, knowledge, tasks and 13 core-skill categories linked to occupations and qualifications
integration_detail: Compare core-skill categories with EMST transversal layer; potential crosswalk for international mobility; monitor governance model

name: Lightcast Open Skills / Skills taxonomy
what_it_illuminates: Skills extracted from postings; demand signals
latest_release_or_status: Four-week release cycle (2024 notice); current cadence unverified
integration_detail: Crosswalk EMST tools layer and tasks to Lightcast skill IDs to read posting-based demand signals into L5 (IA/LM to confirm licensing)

name: WEF Global Skills Taxonomy
what_it_illuminates: Hierarchical shared skills language (93 granular skills) with adoption toolkit
integration_detail: Low priority; possible high-level crosswalk for employer communications

name: Open Skills Management Tool (OSMT) and Rich Skill Descriptors
what_it_illuminates: Open skill-statement libraries linked to Credential Registry (CTDL)
integration_detail: Publish EMST competencies as RSDs/CTDL for credential and learning-system interoperability (IA/LC)

name: OPM occupational series modernization and consolidation
what_it_illuminates: Consolidation of 115 low-use/obsolete series; future skills-based structural redesign
integration_detail: Version-track EMST role-profile crosswalks to OPM series as series consolidate; position EMST as an input to later skills-based redesign phases (FH/AS)

name: OpenLMP (machine-readable land management plans)
sector_focus: Federal and state land management plans
what_it_illuminates: 58,544 plan components (desired conditions, standards, monitoring requirements, coordination touchpoints)
integration_detail: Ingest plan components as demand signals in L5 linked to EMST tasks (e.g. monitoring requirements -> monitoring tasks); reuse governance and provenance patterns
